description: This file defines the SiloHostedService class, which implements the IHostedService interface to manage the lifecycle of an Orleans Silo, including starting and stopping it with logging and configuration validation.

classes.name: SiloHostedService
classes.description: A hosted service managing the lifecycle of an Orleans Silo, with methods to start and stop the silo, and internal logging.

methods.name: SiloHostedService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the service with a Silo instance, configuration validators, and a logger.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Starts the Orleans Silo asynchronously, with logging before and after startup.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the Orleans Silo asynchronously, with logging before and after shutdown.

methods.name: ValidateSystemConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the system configuration using provided configuration validators.

methods.name: LogInformationStartingSilo
methods.description: Logs the message indicating the silo is starting.

methods.name: LogInformationSiloStarted
methods.description: Logs the message indicating the silo has started.

methods.name: LogInformationStoppingSilo
methods.description: Logs the message indicating the silo is stopping.

methods.name: LogInformationSiloStopped
methods.description: Logs the message indicating the silo has stopped.
